groups.rationale: Merges ADR-0237 Windows custodian same-boot recovery (guest-native vscode-web-broker: per-boot custodian generations, generation-scoped job/pipe/version-2 receipts, logon-session quiescence before retiring a prior receipt; windows-editor-v1 stays unselected, native execution pending) with the already-pushed Android display firewall, editor broker readiness and FreeBSD wrong-CID fault-kernel evidence. No catch-all source changed; shared chapters 17, 21 and 22 changed only for ADR-0237, which adds no Ash domain, host, service or deployment placement.

FreeBSD fault-kernel reset-race evidence: chapters 07/19/20 now record 64 racing invalid resets fencing the socket domain under live traffic (native-freebsd-wrong-cid pass, receipt ceaf0283), with production kernels refusing both test OIDs; valid-reset races, DMA and OmniOS stay gaps.
